rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you so much for reaching out — I really appreciated meeting you at the meetup too. I've been thinking seriously about what Halcyon Threshold should focus on, and I've landed on independent AI evaluation as our core mission. The idea: make AI safety research more accessible to policymakers and journalists, identify gaps in current measurement approaches, and eventually build capacity to run independent evaluations. With your data analysis background, you could be hugely helpful on a few fronts: 1. **Evaluation Distillation**: Helping research and summarize existing AI benchmarks (MMLU, HELM, etc.) for non-technical audiences. This is reading + synthesis + clear writing. 2. **Gap Analysis**: When we start cataloging what's being measured and what isn't, having someone who understands data quality and methodology would be valuable. 3. **Eventually**: Running actual evaluations on open-source models. Would any of these interest you? If you want, we could do a 30-minute call to talk through specifics. Happy to work around your schedule. Thanks again for volunteering — it means a lot. Morgan"
rows.quote: Priya (volunteer): Explained focus, offered collaboration options

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Tessa Brandt <t.brandt@larkindispatch.com> with subject "Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'?". It read: "Hi Tessa, Thanks for reaching out. I'm glad Halcyon Threshold came up at the meetup. Unfortunately, I'm not able to be quoted by name right now — I need to sort out some things with my current employer first. I expect that'll be resolved in the next week or two. If you'd like to reconnect after your deadline passes, I'd be happy to talk more about what we're building. The framing of \"doomers vs. builders\" is interesting to me — I think a lot of us don't fit neatly into either camp. Good luck with the piece! Morgan"
rows.quote: Tessa (reporter): Politely declined quote due to HR situation
